title: Washington Fishing Map
identified: 2026-10-18, named by Daniel when asking for improvements
what: One app with four tabs (Map | Year | Spots | Counts) since 2026-10-20. Map: a full-bleed Washington map with three modes. Recent reports: eight SW Washington salmon waters rated from sourced catch reports (Kalama Slow from the source's own word; Washougal counts-only) plus WDFW weekly creel counts; every named river is tappable for its USGS typical flow for the month and WDFW notices, which never colour anything. Typical season: 540 piers, boat launches and shore access sites statewide coloured by the WA Fish Map app's seasonal timing, with WDFW creel counts on nine matched sites. Spawning: 75 WDFW salmon viewing sites coloured by typical spawning timing for a chosen month. My location is set by hand and kept in the viewer's browser. Year, Spots and Counts are the Washington Fishing Year, Three Friends Fishing Hole and SW Washington Creel Table pages, built into the app by scripts/build_app_tabs.py. Counts and timing never mix with ratings.
note: 16 published paths. Map: index.html (the page file) plus geo.js, rivers-tap.js, rules.js, reports.js, counts.js, creel.js, typical.js, season.js, cluster.js and sites.js from this folder. Tabs: year/index.html, year/data.js, spots/index.html, counts/index.html, counts/data.js from this folder's year/, spots/ and counts/, generated by scripts/build_app_tabs.py from Artifacts/fishing-year, Artifacts/three-friends-fishing-hole and Artifacts/salmon-catch-table (the generated index.html files carry a 'Generated by' comment after the doctype that the live copies lack; otherwise identical).
